data.action: 靠在浴池水下长凳，一手撑住瓷砖，另一手沿大腿内侧检查治疗线。
data.description: 成年凯尔希穿着湿白内衫靠在浴池的水下长凳，一手撑住瓷砖，另一手沿大腿内侧检查治疗线；蓝光映着水汽。
data.lighting: 侧窗冷蓝光穿过水汽，在水下长凳和瓷砖接缝留下折射条纹
data.nsfwProse: Her damp white cotton undershirt clings semi-transparently to her skin with no bra beneath, falling to mid-thigh above her bare legs in the clear bathwater.
data.promptProse: In the Rhodes Island medical bath, Kal'tsit reclines along the built-in underwater bench in a wet white cotton undershirt. Set the view slightly above the waterline, looking along the bench through the clear water. One palm bears her weight on the broad tiled ledge, and she uses the tips of her other hand to trace the narrow blue treatment strip on the inside of her thigh above the knee. Blue light through frosted glass ripples over the tile joints at the front of the pool. Steam gathers along the farther wall around a metal handrail, with a small patch of warm light above the water.
data.title: 凯尔希 · 医疗部浴间
data.animaCaption: Reclining along the submerged stone bench in her clinging see-through wet white shirt, Kal'tsit braces one palm on the tiled ledge and traces a narrow blue treatment mark along her raised inner thigh. Cool blue light through the steam ripples over the clear water and ceramic tiles.
